description: Install with --unified-skills and ask Claude Code, headlessly and without tools, which pan- skills it can see; the answer measures whether a unified install gives Claude a working command surface.
why: ADR-0028's default-on gate (P4) was never live-measured on Claude Code. Claude Code's skills documentation lists no .agents/skills/ location, so since R32 (2026-09-22) a unified install also copies every compiled skill into .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Unified skill names are pan-<command> (no colon); the swept proprietary commands were /pan:<command>, so a colon-free name in the answer shows the copy is loaded.

steps.why: The installer's contract before the question is asked: the shared tree exists, Claude's own copy of it exists (R32), and the nested commands are swept so any pan- name in the answer can only come from the copy.

steps.prompt: Without using any tools, list the names of the skills currently available to you whose names begin with pan- (with a hyphen, not a colon), one per line, exactly as they are spelled. Then print the single word DONE on its own line.
steps.why: If Claude Code loads the .claude/skills copy, pan-help appears. If it does not, the answer holds no hyphenated PAN name at all — the commands were swept — and the assertion fails. That failure would mean a unified install leaves Claude Code with no PAN commands, the defect R32 closed statically.
